messages:
DeployBot: INCIDENT alert - quality regression detected for model 'redwood-xxl:2026-03-15' (elevated hallucination rate on rerank tests) — triggered at 2026-03-15T01:14:48Z. Pager: @Liam

Maya: @Liam oncall, can you confirm impact? We have customer error reports and rising eval alerts.

Liam: On it. Starting triage. Paging Samir for model-side. Assigning severity 2 for now. ETA 10m.

Samir: Joining. Loading recent canary metrics. I see token-level divergence around step 4. Possible tokenizer change in last deploy. Reproducing locally.

Eva: Support: received 4 customer tickets referencing bad completions since ~00:45Z. Two are high-priority (customer A,B). QA says outputs are confidently wrong.

Liam: Mitigation plan: 1) Roll back canary to previous model variant 2026-03-12. 2) Pin production traffic to stable variant. 3) Post status page update and customer notice drafts. 4) Collect sample inputs/outputs. Who can run the rollback?

Samir: I can trigger a canary revert but prefer infra to pin route-level config to avoid traffic flip overlap. Liam, can you pin via control plane?

Liam: Doing pin now. Command:

```
# pin model at route level
curl -X POST "https://console.internal/api/v1/routes/pin" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/chat","model":"redwood-xxl:2026-03-12","reason":"quality regression 03/15"}'
```

Liam: Pin request accepted. Routing shows 100% to pinned variant in 75s. Observability: latency normalizing.

Oncall Bot: @Liam accepted the incident, severity S2. Handoff required in 45m.

Maya: Drafting status page. Proposed text:

"Status: Degraded quality for model 'redwood-xxl'. Impact: Some customers may receive incorrect completions for chat and rerank flows. Mitigation: Traffic pinned to a previous verified model variant. ETA for full remediation: investigation ongoing. Updates: every 30 minutes."

Maya: Can Customer Ops send the following notice? (paste)

"Customer notice draft:
Hi — we're investigating a model quality regression affecting some chat responses. We've pinned traffic to a stable model and will update within 30 minutes. If you see critical failures, reply here or contact support@redwood.ai with 'URGENT: model-quality'."

Customer Ops: Sending now to affected customers list (A,B,C). Will attach sample outputs you provide.

Samir: Collecting 20 failing samples to attach. Also running diff between tokenizer configs.

Samir: Found the bad commit: tokenization mapping update (commit d4f2a3) landed in canary pipeline. It altered special token handling. Preparing rollback PR and change log.

Liam: For internal comms: suggested slack blurb for #product and #support:

"Short internal blurb:
We've observed a model quality regression for redwood-xxl due to tokenizer commit in canary. Traffic pinned to 2026-03-12 variant. Engineers are reverting the tokenization change. Customers informed; monitoring in place. Contact oncall@redwood for urgent escalations"

Maya: Also prepping customer-facing release note if rollback confirmed.

Eva: Support: notifying customers A and B that we've pinned their traffic and asking for verification.

Oncall Bot: Reminder: please hand off to next oncall in 45m. If ongoing, escalate to S1.

Liam: Interim status: after pin, error reports down to 1/4 previous. Samples attached in thread. Continuing rollback and full deploy to follow. Next update in 20m.

Samir: PR opened: revert tokenization mapping, running CI (est. 18m). If CI passes we'll deploy to canary then promote.

Maya: Timeline note: if rollback deploy successful and canary stable for 30m, we'll unpin and close incident.

Customer Ops: Customer C reports improvement; Customer A verifying now.

Liam: Thanks all. Handoff at 02:00Z to @Samir if still active. I'll update status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-20260315-01
